verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's core product includes event-triggered flows/automations (docs-17, docs-19, docs-35) and an autonomous Customer Agent that resolves customer queries and sends updates without human intervention (docs-26), directly matching background-running automation for an AI-native user. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of autonomous reliability at scale, and deeper documentation on monitoring/error-handling for unattended flows.
